summary: This clinical study is testing two different food supplements, called Cynacol and Metacol, in people who have mild hypercholesterolemia, which means having mild levels of high cholesterol in the blood. The goal is to see how these supplements affect cholesterol levels over a period of three months. A total of 40 participants between the ages of 35 and 70 will take part in the research. Fondazione IRCCS Policlinico San Matteo di Pavia is sponsoring the study, which is currently recruiting patients.
